headline: Bank OZK Profit Tops Forecasts as Credit Quality Improves
summary: Arkansas-based Bank OZK delivered better-than-expected quarterly earnings as credit quality improved and the lender diversified away from commercial real estate.
why: Bank OZK is closely followed by bank investors as an indicator of commercial real estate construction loan performance.

impacts.name: Bank OZK
impacts.why: Earnings topping expectations combined with stable credit metrics reassure investors about loan health.
